payload.title: VRAM budgeting
payload.body: Your GPU has a fixed amount of VRAM. Each loaded model takes a chunk. The VRAM bar shows what's left. If you load too many, the last one falls back to CPU (slower but works).

payload.title: Export your chats
payload.body: Every conversation can be exported as Markdown or JSON. Use the actions menu in the chat sidebar. Your data, your format.

payload.title: No internet required
payload.body: Once your models are downloaded, everything runs offline. Chat, search, voice — all local. The internet is only needed to download new models.

payload.title: Context length matters
payload.body: A model's context length is how much text it can see at once. 4K = a few pages. 32K = a small book. 128K = a novel. Longer context uses more VRAM.

payload.title: Voice is two models
payload.body: Speech-to-text (your voice → text) and text-to-speech (AI text → spoken voice) are separate models. You can have one without the other.

payload.title: devpulse.json manifests
payload.body: Each model folder can have a devpulse.json that tells the system what the model does. Without it, DevPulse guesses from filenames and metadata.
